data.name: Fayiz
data.gender_notes: Fayiz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ifta'a', meaning 'to open, to let go, to release'. In Islamic context, Fayiz refers to one who is successful, victorious, and triumphant. In the Quran, Allah says, 'And We have given you a clear victory.' (Al-Fatiha 1:5). The name Fayiz carries the meaning “Successful, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fayiz usually hope their child will grow to embody successful, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of Allah's blessings and success in this world and the hereafter.
data.etymology: Fayiz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Successful, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fayiz total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
